text:
Nora Bell: Putting together a one-page CS Ops pocket card for handoffs — single health score + signal tiers + crisp caching/batching/streaming bullets for customers. Want it short, non-jargon, actionable. Thoughts?

Diego Morales: Love the idea. Suggest we include a trend component — current snapshot + 24h delta — so renewals see direction, not just a number.

Amira Hassan: Agree. Also add simple renewal flags: rolling drop in health >12 points in 7d, repeated stream disconnects (>3 in 24h), and engagement <30% of expected. Those map to "red" actions.

Jason Li: For explainability, propose a tiny formula that's easy to read by reps: base_score (0-100) = 0.3*activation_pct + 0.3*success_pct + 0.2*prefetch_pct + 0.1*latency_score + 0.1*trend_bonus. Trend bonus = clamp((24h_delta_pct), -10, +10). Bands: <50 critical, 50-69 watch, >=70 healthy.

Nora Bell: Nice. Keep input names plain: Activation, Success, Prefetch, Latency, Trend. We'll display drivers (top 3) alongside score.

Diego Morales: Ops action tiers (concise):
- Immediate (0-1h): enable short prefix cache, bump prefetch retries to 2, notify customer with one-line note.
- Short (1-24h): run controlled prefetch trial (smaller batches, extended window), reduce token budget for spikes.
- Medium (1-7d): batch timeout tuning + move to warm pool if sustained.

Amira Hassan: Customer-facing bullets for caching/batching/streaming (very small):
- Caching: "Use template keys, keep personal data out. TTL by workload: quick-UX=1h, repeated-answers=24h, analytics=7d."
- Batching: "Start small: batch_size=6, timeout=30ms. If latency SLO holds, grow by +2 every 30m up to 24. Watch 95p latency."
- Streaming: "Prefer for interactivity. On disconnect: replay last 128 tokens + delta-prefetch. If reconnects >2 within 1h, open ticket."

Jason Li: Add cache key hygiene note: key = hash(normalize(prompt_template) + model_version + intent_tag). Avoid user_id in key. This prevents PII leaks and improves hit rates.

Nora Bell: Short failure-mode playbook lines: cache-miss storm -> throttle prefetch jobs or route to dedicated small pool; high tail latency -> reduce batch growth or cap concurrent batches; stream flapping -> enable sticky session pinning to warm pool. Include a quick command for SRE to start a trial: `redwood-prefetch run --tenant acme-corp --batch 12 --window 3h --tag cs-trial`

Diego Morales: Nice SRE bits. Also add a metric trigger set: stream_err_rate > 2% for 30m, prefetch_success < 78% for 2h, activation drop >12 pts over 72h. Those auto-create a ticket.

Amira Hassan: Feedback capture: 48h micro-survey with 3 items: 1) Did discovery latency improve? (Y/N) 2) Any functional regressions? (free text) 3) Rate current confidence (1-5). Also add a checkbox for "seen cost change" (Y/N). Persist answers as events for next day's snapshot.

Jason Li: Customer email template (one paragraph):
"Hi <owner>, quick update: current health score 64 (watch). Top drivers: Prefetch 71%, Activation 55%, Latency 95p 1.2s. Quick wins we applied: short prefix cache, small prefetch trial, capped token budget. Can we book 20m to review next steps?"

Nora Bell: Nice tone. For renewal prep add a 30/90 day sparkline and persistent driver list (things unresolved for >14d). That helps sales have evidence in the convo.

OpsBot: AUTOGEN: sample telemetry line to paste in the pocket card:
`{"tenant":"acme-corp","health_score":64,"drivers":{"prefetch_pct":71,"activation_pct":55,"latency_95p_ms":1200},"24h_delta":-6,"ts":1799901234}`

Diego Morales: One more thing — include a two-step batch-growth policy snippet for CS: "If 95p latency < SLO and success_rate > 95% for 2 consecutive 30m windows then batch_size +=2; else revert last growth." That gives a safe autoscaling play.

Amira Hassan: I'll proof the customer wording to ensure it's non-technical.

Jason Li: I'll add the SRE commands and the exact watch thresholds to the ops appendix.

Nora Bell: I'll assemble the pocket card (single A4): left column = score + drivers + sparkline, middle = ops action tiers, right = customer bullets + email + survey link. Draft by Wed EOD. Reviewers: @Amira, @Jason.

OpsBot: Reminder set: Nora draft due Wed 17:00 PST. :memo:
